name: create_users_table_schema
description: Creates a SQL schema for a users table with a unique, non-null email column
prompts: Write a SQL schema file named schema.sql that creates a table called `users` with the following columns: `id` (integer primary key, autoincrementing), `email` (text, must be unique and must never be null), and `created_at` (text, must never be null, intended to hold an ISO-8601 timestamp). Do not add any other tables.

test_setup_files.test_schema.py:
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
with open('schema.sql', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    conn.executescript(f.read())

cols = {row[1]: row for row in conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info(users)').fetchall()}
assert 'id' in cols, f'users table missing id column: {cols}'
assert 'email' in cols, f'users table missing email column: {cols}'
assert 'created_at' in cols, f'users table missing created_at column: {cols}'
assert cols['email'][3] == 1, f'email column must be NOT NULL, got {cols["email"]}'
assert cols['created_at'][3] == 1, f'created_at column must be NOT NULL, got {cols["created_at"]}'

conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (email, created_at) VALUES ('a@example.com', '2026-01-01T00:00:00')")
conn.commit()

try:
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (email, created_at) VALUES ('a@example.com', '2026-01-02T00:00:00')")
    conn.commit()
    raise AssertionError('expected duplicate email insert to fail')
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    pass

try:
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (email, created_at) VALUES (NULL, '2026-01-03T00:00:00')")
    conn.commit()
    raise AssertionError('expected NULL email insert to fail')
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    pass

try:
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (email, created_at) VALUES ('b@example.com', NULL)")
    conn.commit()
    raise AssertionError('expected NULL created_at insert to fail')
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    pass

print('PASS')
